accepted.name: berne-shipping-paper-v1
accepted.prompt: Create two separate transparent game props side by side. These are FRONT and BACK of a SINGLE THIN HANDWRITTEN SHIPPING LEDGER PAGE, taken out of a stitched book. They are NOT luggage tags, not a bundle, not a scroll. Ordinary roughly A5 off-white sheet, nearly rectangular with very slightly creased corner, one fold crease across middle, drawn face-on with a slight elevated angle. At UPPER-LEFT EDGE two tiny stitching punctures, with TWO VERY FINE SHORT FRAYED THREAD ENDS (like sewing thread). Threads at most3%of page width, NEVER thick rope, NEVER a knot or loop. Front: six small dark brown handwritten inventory strokes in simple groups, no readable letters. Back: mostly plain paper, faint fold crease, same torn edge/punctures and tiny threads. Same outline and size on both sides. Paper edge is razor thin, NO stacked layers, tag holes or leather border. Warm handpainted2D RPG prop medium, restrained brown lines. Entire objects separated by wide transparent gutters. True transparent alpha. No text labels, hands, people, decorations, scenery or shadows.
accepted.use: Accepted front and back of thin folded shipping document with frayed binding thread

accepted.name: aria-lunch-v1
accepted.prompt: Create8full-body warm painted RPG character poses in EXACT4columns2rows on transparent background. Image1 is the SAME character and body/face/outfit/style reference. Preserve physical head size, limb lengths, face, hair, clothes, boots. Elevated45degree camera. Canonical facing SCREEN RIGHT for ALL poses; sprites are later flipped for the opposite side. Row1 col0 STANDING neutral calibration, col1 seated on ground with folded legs/knees naturally in front and boots visible, relaxed hands lap; col2 same seated with near palm upward at lap ready to support small food NOT DRAWN; col3 same seated, one near arm extends naturally forward screen-right to offer food NOT DRAWN, hand reaches beyond front knee, no body lean into a neighboring person. Row2 col0 same seated brings empty near hand toward mouth to bite small food NOT DRAWN; col1 same seated LEANS FORWARD from hip and reaches one hand diagonally DOWN AND FORWARD to pick food off an unseen picnic cloth, fingertips about ONE FOOT-LENGTH beyond front toe, level with the floor in front, planted boots NEVER move; col2 same seated leans forward with BOTH hands close together at the same forward floor position to wrap a small parcel/tie a string NOT DRAWN, legs and planted boots unchanged; col3 same seated LEANS FORWARD and lowers one hand toward floor to put down a flask NOT DRAWN, hand extends beyond front knee to same floor reach, other hand supports knee. Important low reaching hands must be in front of boots on screen-right, not between knees or behind heels. No food, flask, string, cloth, floor or furniture in sprites. All sitting poses visibly LOWER than standing yet SAME head/body/boot scale; generous transparent gutters around every full silhouette. Fine brown outlines, soft natural shading, no pixel grid, no labels/text, no backgrounds/shadows. Keep character identity, not generic adorable redesign.
accepted.use: New seated reach and wrapping poses; one standing calibration per atlas
